copy.tagline_en: Generate a quick-start guide for new team members

howto.what: Claude 会读取项目的知识图谱,生成一份新人入职指南,包含项目概览、架构分层、关键概念、引导式导览、文件地图和复杂度热点,并可保存为 docs/ONBOARDING.md。
howto.when: 当你需要为新加入项目的团队成员生成入职指南时触发;若 .understand-anything/knowledge-graph.json 不存在,它会让你先运行 /understand。

say.text: 把这份入职指南保存到 docs/ONBOARDING.md
say.note: 写入项目的 docs 目录

howto.what_en: Claude reads the project's knowledge graph and generates an onboarding guide with overview, architecture layers, key concepts, a guided tour, file map, and complexity hotspots, and can save it to docs/ONBOARDING.md.
howto.when_en: Use when you need an onboarding guide for new team members joining a project. If .understand-anything/knowledge-graph.json is missing, it asks you to run /understand first.

say_en.text: Generate an onboarding guide for a new teammate.
say_en.note: Builds it from the knowledge graph

say_en.text: Save the onboarding guide to docs/ONBOARDING.md.
say_en.note: Writes it into the project docs
